description: Ruyschstraat 72-98 and the 1898-1904 rows around it (strip 2023-01-02, gridded 40 px/m): dark red-brown brick, 3 axes on 5.6 m, one ground storey and three uppers, 1.15 x 2.1 m sash windows under cambered brick heads, the centre axis a French window with an iron balconette on every upper storey, a cream cornice with a brick frieze above the top row (13.1-13.6 m), a slate mansard behind it and one white box dormer per house
